## The Creation

Edit this BibleLens Story illustration into a visually distinct second proposal. Use the attached image as the style and character reference. Keep a sophisticated painterly editorial medium, believable human anatomy, dignified ancient Near Eastern/African appearances with brown skin and natural textured dark hair, simple early woven or hide garments as appropriate, and the same underlying narrative. The image is an imagined literary illustration, not historical evidence. Landscape 16:9, edge-to-edge, no lettering, logos, borders or watermark. Keep central focal subjects crop-safe for Story cards and a Read banner. No depicted deity, halos, fantasy armor, nudity, gore or modern objects. Crucially, replace the repeated golden sunset, ochre valley, distant blue mountains and framing olive tree look. New setting and lighting: Genesis 1:1–2:3. Recompose as a vast ocean-and-sky scene at blue hour just before sunrise. A curving shoreline with dark sculptural rock shelves and newly lush green headlands forms a low diagonal, translucent turquoise water breaking into white foam, a few small seabirds rising through sea mist. The immense upper sky grades from deep indigo with a few fading stars to violet, pale rose and a thin luminous dawn horizon. A feeling of emergence, scale and open space. No visible golden sun disk, river valley, foreground tree, humans, elephants or antelope. Rich cool blues and pearl-white water should make this image instantly distinct from the four human stories. It illustrates the text poetically, without claiming a scientific sequence.
